scenes.script_line: Something happens at work. You interpret it — you think about what it means. That thought shapes what you do next. And what you do produces the result you see. Event, interpretation, action, result.
scenes.visual_direction: A cause-and-effect sequence: a workplace event (something breaks, an instruction arrives), a thoughtful worker pausing to interpret, then acting, then seeing a result. Contemplative but dignified — no dark-stare portraits.

scenes.script_line: Two workers receive the same feedback. One withdraws — steps back from the task, avoids it. The other takes notes, asks a question, practices, and returns. Same words, two completely different outcomes.
scenes.visual_direction: Both halves needed: a worker receiving feedback and withdrawing (head down, stepping back, walking away from the task) AND a worker engaging (taking notes, asking a question, practicing a skill, returning to the work). Dignified trades/land/technical settings.

scenes.script_line: The challenge: write down the old belief. Sketch its table — the experiences holding it up. Cross out one interpretation that no longer serves you. Write the new belief. Then take one visible action on it today.
scenes.visual_direction: A person doing the written exercise: writing in a journal, sketching a diagram, crossing out a line, writing a new line — then closing the notebook and taking one visible action (standing up, picking up tools, making the call, starting the task).
